title: Compactness of spheres in finite dimensional real normed spaces
statement: Let $E$ be a finite dimensional normed vector space over $\mathbb R$, with the topology induced by its norm, let $c\in E$, and let $r\in\mathbb R$. The sphere $\{x\in E:\|x-c\|=r\}$ is compact in its subspace topology [def-kun-subspace-topology].
